Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement modular energy budget system for CENOP-JASMINE merge \(Phase 4\)

Add JASMINE Dynamic Energy Budget \(DEB\) model while preserving DEPONS
compatibility. The system supports dual-mode operation: DEPONS for
regulatory compliance and JASMINE for detailed bioenergetics research.

Key features:
- EnergyState/EnergyContext/EnergyResult dataclasses for vectorized ops
- DEPONSEnergyModule: Simple 0-20 energy scale \(backward compatible\)
- JASMINEEnergyModule: Full DEB with Kleiber scaling, thermoregulation,
  activity costs, and cumulative disturbance impact tracking
- Factory function create_energy_module\(params, mode\) for easy instantiation
- Integration with Simulation and PorpoisePopulation via optional parameter
- 26 new tests covering both energy modules

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement disturbance memory and learned avoidance for CENOP-JASMINE merge \(Phase 5\)

Add JASMINE memory/cognition system for tracking disturbance zones and
enabling learned avoidance behavior. DEPONS mode remains stateless for
regulatory compliance.

Key features:
- DisturbanceMemoryState: Per-agent sparse spatial memory grids
- DEPONSMemoryModule: No-op implementation \(stateless deterrence\)
- JASMINEMemoryModule: Full memory with decay and avoidance
  - Spatial grid matching PSM structure \(2km cells\)
  - Configurable exponential memory decay
  - Learned avoidance vectors from remembered disturbances
  - Cumulative exposure and habituation tracking
- Integration with movement: avoidance combined with deterrence
- 22 new tests covering both memory modes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
